title: Combined computational modeling and experimental analysis integrating chemical and mechanical signals suggests possible mechanism of shoot meristem maintenance.
authors: Banwarth-Kuhn, Mikahl; Rodriguez, Kevin; Michael, Christian; Ta, Calvin-Khang; Plong, Alexander; Bourgain-Chang, Eric; Nematbakhsh, Ali; Chen, Weitao; Roy-Chowdhury, Amit; Reddy, G Venugopala; Alber, Mark
one_liner_zh: 该文用多尺度计算模型结合实验研究植物茎尖分生组织中WUSCHEL和细胞分裂素与机械应力对细胞分裂方向的调控，虽涉及转录因子WUSCHEL但未聚焦其与DNA结合互作，且方法为组织尺度建模而非AI或分子模拟，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Stem cell maintenance in multilayered shoot apical meristems (SAMs) of plants requires strict regulation of cell growth and division. Exactly how the complex milieu of chemical and mechanical signals interact in the central region of the SAM to regulate cell division plane orientation is not well understood. In this paper, simulations using a newly developed multiscale computational model are combined with experimental studies to suggest and test three hypothesized mechanisms for the regulation of cell division plane orientation and the direction of anisotropic cell expansion in the corpus. Simulations predict that in the Apical corpus, WUSCHEL and cytokinin regulate the direction of anisotropic cell expansion, and cells divide according to tensile stress on the cell wall. In the Basal corpus, model simulations suggest dual roles for WUSCHEL and cytokinin in regulating both the direction of anisotropic cell expansion and cell division plane orientation. Simulation results are followed by a detailed analysis of changes in cell characteristics upon manipulation of WUSCHEL and cytokinin in experiments that support model predictions. Moreover, simulations predict that this layer-specific mechanism maintains both the experimentally observed shape and structure of the SAM as well as the distribution of WUSCHEL in the tissue. This provides an additional link between the roles of WUSCHEL, cytokinin, and mechanical stress in regulating SAM growth and proper stem cell maintenance in the SAM.
abstract_zh: 植物多层茎尖分生组织（SAM）中的干细胞维持需要严格调控细胞生长与分裂。化学信号与机械信号在SAM中央区域如何相互作用以调控细胞分裂平面方向，目前尚不完全清楚。本文中，利用新开发的多尺度计算模型进行模拟，并结合实验研究，提出并检验了三种关于细胞分裂平面方向及细胞团（corpus）中各向异性细胞扩张方向调控的假设机制。模拟预测，在顶端细胞团（Apical corpus）中，WUSCHEL和细胞分裂素调控各向异性细胞扩张的方向，而细胞根据细胞壁上的张应力进行分裂。在基部细胞团（Basal corpus）中，模型模拟表明WUSCHEL和细胞分裂素在调控各向异性细胞扩张方向和细胞分裂平面方向方面具有双重作用。模拟结果之后，通过实验中操纵WUSCHEL和细胞分裂素对细胞特征变化的详细分析，支持了模型预测。此外，模拟预测这种层特异性机制维持了实验中观察到的SAM形状和结构以及WUSCHEL在组织中的分布。这为WUSCHEL、细胞分裂素和机械应力在调控SAM生长及SAM中正常干细胞维持中的作用提供了额外联系。
